    UXenoCoreContentSettings¶

    Class · derives from UDeveloperSettings · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/XenoCoreContentSettings.h

    Assets XenoCore spawns or applies from code that are not UI. Project Settings > Game > XenoCore Content. Every entry defaults to the shipped asset.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Starting Roster Override StartingRosterOverride TArray<TSoftObjectPtr<UXenoCorePartyMemberDefinition>> Startup Config, EditAnywhere Non-empty replaces the party component's authored StartingRoster for a New Game. A load restores from the save.
    New Game Map Override NewGameMapOverride TSoftObjectPtr<UWorld> Startup Config, EditAnywhere Set = New Game opens this map instead of the title screen's authored NewGameMap.
    Title Music TitleMusic TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Startup Config, EditAnywhere Played 2D while the title screen is up. Cleared = a silent title.
    Title Music Volume TitleMusicVolume float Startup Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=2.0 1.0 Volume multiplier for the title music.
    Fallback Field Music FallbackFieldMusic TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Startup Config, EditAnywhere Played by an Area Music actor whose own Field Music slot is empty. The map's own track always wins; cleared = that area is silent.
    Fallback Battle Music FallbackBattleMusic TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Startup Config, EditAnywhere As Fallback Field Music, for an Area Music actor whose Battle Music slot is empty.
    Dialogue Anchor DialogueAnchor TSoftClassPtr<AXenoCoreDialogueAnchor> Dialogue Config, EditAnywhere The actor that carries the dialogue box over whoever is speaking. Must derive from XenoCoreDialogueAnchor.
    Dialogue Camera Rig DialogueCameraRig TSoftObjectPtr<UCameraRigAsset> Dialogue Config, EditAnywhere The camera that frames a conversation: it blends in when an NPC starts talking and back out when the talk ends. Cleared = the camera stays where it was.
    Dialogue Turn Seconds DialogueTurnSeconds float Dialogue Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=2.0, Units=s 0.3 How long the player and the NPC take to turn and face each other when a conversation opens (and the NPC to turn back after). 0 snaps.
    Beam Material BeamMaterial TSoftObjectPtr<UMaterialInterface> Feedback Config, EditAnywhere The material of the light shaft a heal or buff raises over its target. Drives Colour, Intensity and Opacity parameters.
    Victory Fanfare VictoryFanfare TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Battle Config, EditAnywhere Played once, 2D, the moment a battle is won. Cleared = no fanfare (the party still celebrates).
    Battle Voice Config BattleVoiceConfig TSoftObjectPtr<UXenoCoreBattleVoiceConfig> Voice Config, EditAnywhere Pacing and playback for every party voice line. Cleared = the party is silent.
    Gem Registry GemRegistry TSoftObjectPtr<UXenoCoreGemRegistry> Items Config, EditAnywhere Every gem, by id, and the effect gem stats are applied through. Cleared = the shipped registry.
    Ally Damage Taken Sound AllyDamageTakenSound TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Battle Config, EditAnywhere Played at a companion when it takes damage. Cleared = companions take hits silently.
    Ally Damage Taken Critical Sound AllyDamageTakenCriticalSound TSoftObjectPtr<USoundBase> Battle Config, EditAnywhere As Ally Damage Taken Sound, on a critical hit. Cleared = the normal sound plays for crits too.
    Ally Damage Taken Volume AllyDamageTakenVolume float Battle Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=2.0 0.7 Volume of the companion hit sounds. Below 1 so the player's own hits stay the loudest.
    Critical Hit Text CriticalHitText FText Critical Hit Config, EditAnywhere The line raised over the target on a critical hit. Says hit, so it cannot be read as "critical health".
    Critical Hit Scale CriticalHitScale float Critical Hit Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.25, ClampMax=4.0 1.15 Resting size of the critical line. Break / topple / daze are 1.
    Critical Hit Punch CriticalHitPunch float Critical Hit Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=1.0, ClampMax=4.0 1.7 The critical line starts this many times its resting size and snaps down to it. 1 = no punch.
    Critical Hit Stop Seconds CriticalHitStopSeconds float Critical Hit Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=0.5, Units=s 0.0 Hit-stop on a critical hit, in real seconds. 0 = off (XC1 has none).
    Critical Hit Stop Dilation CriticalHitStopDilation float Critical Hit Config, EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.01, ClampMax=1.0 0.05 World speed during the hit-stop.
    Reaction Break Effect ReactionBreakEffect TSoftClassPtr<UGameplayEffect> Debug Config, EditAnywhere The Break effect the XenoCore.Reaction debug command reads its duration from.
    Reaction Topple Effect ReactionToppleEffect TSoftClassPtr<UGameplayEffect> Debug Config, EditAnywhere The Topple effect the XenoCore.Reaction debug command reads its duration from.
    Reaction Daze Effect ReactionDazeEffect TSoftClassPtr<UGameplayEffect> Debug Config, EditAnywhere The Daze effect the XenoCore.Reaction debug command reads its duration from.

    FXenoCoreCombatAIProfile¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/AI/XenoCoreCombatAIProfile.h · BlueprintType

    How one AI combatant - companion or enemy - behaves in a fight: decision pace, post-art cooldown, heal threshold, positioning.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Decision Interval DecisionInterval float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.1, Units=Seconds 1.5 Seconds between art decisions. The auto-attack keeps swinging in between.
    Decision Jitter DecisionJitter float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=0.9 0.3 Random spread on each interval, as a fraction: 0.3 = 70-130 % (XC3's jitter). Stops companions acting in lockstep.
    Post Art Cooldown PostArtCooldown float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, Units=Seconds 3.0 After using an art, choose no other for this long - on top of the art's own cooldown. (XC3's IntervalArts.)
    Heal Threshold HealThreshold float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0, Units=Percent 30.0 An ally below this much health makes heal arts eligible. 30 is XC2's number; XC1's is unsourced.
    Reliability Reliability float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0, Units=Percent 100.0 Chance to act at all on a decision, 0-100. Below 100 makes a character less dependable, as XC2 does on purpose.
    Seek Positional Bonus bSeekPositionalBonus bool AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly true Move behind or beside the target for an art's positional bonus before using it (XC3). Off = fire from wherever it stands (XC1).
    Positional Timeout PositionalTimeout float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, EditCondition=bSeekPositionalBonus, Units=Seconds 2.0 Give up on reaching position after this long and use the art anyway. Never circles.
    Attacking Me Weight AttackingMeWeight float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 3.0 Engage at Will: score for an enemy that is attacking this character.
    Attacking Ally Weight AttackingAllyWeight float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 1.5 Engage at Will: score for an enemy that is attacking another party member. Raise it on a defender.
    Leader Target Weight LeaderTargetWeight float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 1.0 Raise it to stay with the player's fight.
    Current Target Weight CurrentTargetWeight float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 2.0 Engage at Will: score for the enemy this character is already fighting - stops it flip-flopping.
    Per Ally On Target Weight PerAllyOnTargetWeight float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly -1.0 Engage at Will: added once per other companion already on an enemy. Negative spreads the party out.
    Distance Penalty Per Metre DistancePenaltyPerMetre float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.1 Engage at Will: subtracted per metre of distance, so the near enemy wins a tie.
    Target Reconsider Interval TargetReconsiderInterval float Target Choice EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.1, Units=Seconds 1.0 Engage at Will: how often the choice is reconsidered. A dead target is replaced at once regardless.

    FXenoCorePartyFollowLeaderTask¶

    Struct · derives from FStateTreeTaskCommonBase · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/AI/XenoCorePartyTravelTasks.h

    Trail the leader with one long-lived MoveToActor, speed-matched. Succeeds once the leader has stopped and the member has arrived; the transition then runs RecalculatePosition.

    FXenoCorePartyFollowLeaderTaskInstanceData¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/AI/XenoCorePartyTravelTasks.h

    Tuning and running state for FXenoCorePartyFollowLeaderTask.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Trail Distance TrailDistance float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 260.0 The distance a member settles at behind a moving leader. Roughly XC1's trailing distance.
    Per Slot Spacing PerSlotSpacing float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 90.0 Added per party slot, so members string out rather than converging on one distance.
    Arrive Slack ArriveSlack float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 60.0 Once the leader has stopped, arrive within TrailDistance + this and hand over to RecalculatePosition.
    Leader Stopped Speed LeaderStoppedSpeed float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 20.0 The leader counts as stopped below this ground speed.
    Speed Gain SpeedGain float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 1.2 Speed correction per unit of distance error: speed = leader speed + Gain x (distance - trail).
    Catch Up Ratio CatchUpRatio float Parameter › Pace EditAnywhere, ClampMin=1 1.5 Catch-up never runs faster than leader speed x this, plus CatchUpMargin.
    Catch Up Margin CatchUpMargin float Parameter › Pace EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0, Units=CentimetersPerSecond 120.0 Flat speed added to the catch-up cap on top of leader speed x CatchUpRatio.
    Arrive Speed ArriveSpeed float Parameter › Pace EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0, Units=CentimetersPerSecond 380.0 The pace a member comes in at once the leader has stopped.
    Pace Smoothing PaceSmoothing float Parameter › Pace EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.1 3.0 How fast the chosen pace eases toward its target, per second. Lower is smoother and laggier.
    Min Speed MinSpeed float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 180.0 Never slower than this while following.
    Max Speed MaxSpeed float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 850.0 Never faster than this. Above the player's run, so a member that lost ground regains it.
    Too Close Fraction TooCloseFraction float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0, UIMin=0.0, UIMax=1.0 0.55 Closer than TrailDistance x this is too close - e.g. the leader walked back into the member. Hand over to RecalculatePosition rather than push through the leader's capsule.
    Repath Interval RepathInterval float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 0.5 After a failed or finished path, wait this long before asking the pathfinder again.

    FXenoCorePartyRecalculatePositionTaskInstanceData¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/AI/XenoCorePartyTravelTasks.h

    Tuning and running state for FXenoCorePartyRecalculatePositionTask.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Settle Time SettleTime float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 0.3 Stand still this long after stopping before choosing a spot - the beat of "arriving".
    Settle Jitter SettleJitter float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 0.3 Random extra settle time, per entry.
    Rest Distance RestDistance float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 260.0 How far from the leader the first follower rests. Match Follow's TrailDistance.
    Rest Slot Spacing RestSlotSpacing float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 60.0 Added to RestDistance per slot after the first, so the party rests in shallow tiers.
    Slot Spread Degrees SlotSpreadDegrees float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 35.0 Angular spread between slots, in degrees, around the point directly behind the leader. Slot 1 swings one way, slot 2 the other, slot 3 twice as far one way, and so on.
    Min Reposition Distance MinRepositionDistance float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 90.0 Closer than this to the chosen spot and the member stays exactly where it stopped.
    Max Reposition Distance MaxRepositionDistance float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 400.0 Further than this from the slot behind the leader - e.g. the leader turned round and walked back past the member - and the member instead rests on its own side of the leader. Walking all the way round the leader to reach "behind" reads as fussing.
    Reposition Speed RepositionSpeed float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 200.0 Walk, not run, onto the spot - it is a small correction, not a chase.
    Max Reposition Time MaxRepositionTime float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 2.5 Give up stepping onto the spot after this long, and hold wherever the member is.
    Abort Distance AbortDistance float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 520.0 If the leader is this far away the member should be following, not tidying up: fail, and the transition goes straight back to Follow. Match Hold's FollowStartDistance.
    Per Slot Spacing PerSlotSpacing float Parameter EditAnywhere, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 90.0 Added to AbortDistance per party slot. Match Hold's and Follow's PerSlotSpacing.

    XenoCoreRuntime / AbilitySystem/Attributes¶

    UXenoCoreStatSet¶

    Class · derives from ULyraAttributeSet · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/AbilitySystem/Attributes/XenoCoreStatSet.h · BlueprintType

    Every per-character scalar the XC1 damage formula reads.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Max Character Level MaxCharacterLevel float XenoCore › Progression Config, EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=1, UIMin=1 99.0 The level cap CharacterLevel is clamped to. XC1's is 99.
    Strength Strength FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly Drives auto-attacks and physical arts. Does nothing for ether arts - the split is deliberate and is what makes physical and ether characters play differently at a stat level.
    Ether Ether FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly Drives ether arts only.
    Agility Agility FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly Both evasion and accuracy - it reads on offence and defence from the same number.
    Physical Defence PhysicalDefence FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly No description.
    Ether Defence EtherDefence FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly No description.
    Critical Rate CriticalRate FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly 0-1. A crit is x1.25, or x1.5 against a toppled or dazed target.
    Block Rate BlockRate FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly 0-1. Chance to block a physical hit; a blocked hit keeps the damage execution's Block Multiplier (0 by default, so it is negated - XC1 halves it).
    Weight Weight FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Stats BlueprintReadOnly Summed from equipped armour. Heavier armour trades Agility for defence, so this is an input to Agility rather than a carry limit - XC1 has no encumbrance.
    Weapon Attack Min WeaponAttackMin FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Weapon BlueprintReadOnly The wpn term is a uniform roll in [Min, Max], and the game caps the spread at Min+99.
    Weapon Attack Max WeaponAttackMax FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Weapon BlueprintReadOnly No description.
    Character Level CharacterLevel FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Progression BlueprintReadOnly Feeds the level-difference correction, which swings damage from x0.5 to x2.0. An attribute rather than save data because buffs and debuffs read it.
    Experience Experience FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Progression BlueprintReadOnly EXP banked toward the next level, not a running total.
    Experience To Next Level ExperienceToNextLevel FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Progression BlueprintReadOnly What Experience must reach to level. Written from the character's experience curve on every level change, so the curve is the single source and nothing recomputes it independently.
    Talent Gauge TalentGauge FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Talent BlueprintReadOnly 0-100. Fills as auto-attacks land, and pays for the Talent Art.
    Talent Charge Per Hit TalentChargePerHit FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Talent BlueprintReadOnly Talent Gauge added per landed auto-attack. A percentage of the 0-100 gauge, not a multiplier.
    Auto Attack Speed AutoAttackSpeed FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Combat BlueprintReadOnly How fast auto-attacks come round, as a multiplier on the swing cadence. 1 is normal.
    Move Speed MoveSpeed FGameplayAttributeData XenoCore › Locomotion BlueprintReadOnly Field movement speed, as a percent bonus on the pawn's authored walk speed. 0 is normal.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Gameplay Tag Property Map GameplayTagPropertyMap FGameplayTagBlueprintPropertyMap GameplayTags EditDefaultsOnly Gameplay tags mapped to the variables below. Use this rather than querying tags by hand.

    Falling Alpha FallingAlpha float XenoCore › Locomotion BlueprintReadOnly 0.0 0/1 mirror of bIsFalling, for transition rules that compare floats. GroundSpeed covers the moving/idle transitions; this covers the airborne ones.
    In Battle bInBattle bool XenoCore › Battle BlueprintReadOnly false Battle stance: does the owner's ASC have XenoCoreGameplayTags::Status_XenoCore_InBattle.
    Target Yaw Delta TargetYawDelta float XenoCore › Battle BlueprintReadOnly 0.0 Signed yaw from the character's facing to the held target, in degrees, damped and clamped.
    Has Target bHasTarget bool XenoCore › Battle BlueprintReadOnly false A target is held. Fades the twist out rather than snapping it to zero when one is dropped.
    Max Target Twist MaxTargetTwist float XenoCore › Battle EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=179.0 70.0 How far the chest may turn, total, across the three spine bones.
    Target Twist Interp Rate TargetTwistInterpRate float XenoCore › Battle EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.1 10.0 Degrees-per-second-ish damping on the twist. Higher snaps, lower drifts.
    Smoothed Ground Speed SmoothedGroundSpeed float XenoCore › Locomotion BlueprintReadOnly 0.0 GroundSpeed eased over time, and what the locomotion blend space's Speed axis reads.
    Speed Smoothing Rate SpeedSmoothingRate float XenoCore › Locomotion EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.1, UIMin=0.1 6.0 FInterpTo rate for SmoothedGroundSpeed. Lower is smoother and laggier; too low and the feet visibly disagree with the ground.
    Stride Scale StrideScale float XenoCore › Locomotion BlueprintReadOnly 1.0 Drives the Stride Warping node so cadence can stay native while the body moves faster. GroundSpeed / AuthoredClipSpeed, floored by MinStrideScale.
    Authored Clip Speed AuthoredClipSpeed float XenoCore › Locomotion EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=1.0, UIMin=1.0 400.0 The speed of the fastest clip in the locomotion blend space - the point above which there is no faster animation and stride warping has to cover the difference.
    Min Stride Scale MinStrideScale float XenoCore › Locomotion EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 1.0 Floors the stride so warping can only ever stretch, never compress. 1.0 because the blend space owns everything from walk (200) to jog (400) with real clips - below the fastest clip the right answer is to blend to a slower gait, not to shrink a jog's stride.
    Moving Speed Threshold MovingSpeedThreshold float XenoCore › Locomotion EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 20.0 Below this speed (cm/s) the character is idle. Too low (around 3) and the character leaves Idle on residual velocity and plays a warped-to-nothing jog.
    Wants Idle Break bWantsIdleBreak bool XenoCore › IdleBreak BlueprintReadOnly false Idle break - true while the character, having stood still long enough, should be fidgeting.
    Idle Break Anim IdleBreakAnim TObjectPtr<UAnimSequence> XenoCore › IdleBreak EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly The fidget this stance plays. Set on the layer child, which is what makes the break per-stance and per-gender for free - the feminine layer is already a separate child.
    Look Bone Rotation 0 LookBoneRotation0 FRotator XenoCore › Look BlueprintReadOnly FRotator::ZeroRotator Look rotation for neck_01 (component space, additive). Driven by the gaze.
    Look Bone Rotation 1 LookBoneRotation1 FRotator XenoCore › Look BlueprintReadOnly FRotator::ZeroRotator Look rotation for neck_02 (component space, additive).
    Look Bone Rotation 2 LookBoneRotation2 FRotator XenoCore › Look BlueprintReadOnly FRotator::ZeroRotator Look rotation for head (component space, additive).
    Look Bone Shares LookBoneShares TArray<float> XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly Share of the look each bone carries, in LookBoneRotation0..2 order. Should sum to 1.
    Look Bone Interp Speeds LookBoneInterpSpeeds TArray<float> XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly FInterpTo speed per bone, same order. Higher on the head so it leads.
    Look Max Yaw LookMaxYaw float XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=120, Units=Degrees 70.0 Total head-and-neck yaw either side, after the chest's own twist.
    Look Give Up Yaw LookGiveUpYaw float XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=180, Units=Degrees 125.0 Beyond this the target is behind: look forward instead of craning at the limit.
    Look Max Pitch Up LookMaxPitchUp float XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=80, Units=Degrees 30.0 How far the head may tilt up toward its look target.
    Look Max Pitch Down LookMaxPitchDown float XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=80, Units=Degrees 25.0 How far the head may tilt down toward its look target.
    Look Origin Bone LookOriginBone FName XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly "head" The bone the look is measured from - the eyes are near it.
    Look Blocked By Tags LookBlockedByTags FGameplayTagContainer XenoCore › Look EditDefaultsOnly While the character's ASC holds any of these the head returns forward - a clip is driving it.
    Idle Break Delay IdleBreakDelay float XenoCore › IdleBreak EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 8.0 Seconds of stillness before a break is requested.

    UXenoCoreFaceAnimInstance¶

    Class · derives from UAnimInstance · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Animation/XenoCoreFaceAnimInstance.h · Blueprintable

    The parent of every VRoid body's runtime ABP (ABP_XenoCore_VRoidRetarget_*). The AnimGraph retargets the invisible Mannequin body's pose onto the VRoid mesh, then a Modify Curve node writes FaceCurves - one wire, the node's CurveMap pin - into the pose. The mesh's VRM4U post-process ABP (ABP_Post_*) turns those curves into morph targets through the model's own POSE_face asset, so the expressions are the ones authored in VRoid Studio.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Face Curves FaceCurves TMap<FName, float> XenoCore › Face Transient, BlueprintReadOnly The curve values this frame. Wired to the Modify Curve node's CurveMap pin.
    Expression Rules ExpressionRules TArray<FXenoCoreFaceExpressionRule> XenoCore › Face EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly Gameplay tag -> expression rules, checked in order; the first tag the character holds wins.
    Expression Table ExpressionTable TSoftObjectPtr<UDataTable> XenoCore › Face EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly Named expressions, as mixes of face curves. Rule and PlayExpression names are looked up here first.
    Blink Curve BlinkCurve FName XenoCore › Face › Blink EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly "blink" The face curve the procedural blink drives.
    Blink Interval Min BlinkIntervalMin float XenoCore › Face › Blink EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.1 2.5 Shortest time between blinks, in seconds. Each gap is rolled between Min and Max.
    Blink Interval Max BlinkIntervalMax float XenoCore › Face › Blink EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.1 6.0 Longest time between blinks, in seconds.
    Blink Duration BlinkDuration float XenoCore › Face › Blink EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.05 0.18 Close-and-open time. Real blinks are 0.1-0.4s; under 0.12 the pose asset barely reaches shut.
    Expression Blend Speed ExpressionBlendSpeed float XenoCore › Face EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.1 6.0 How fast an expression eases in and out, per second.
    Talking Tag TalkingTag FGameplayTag XenoCore › Face › Mouth EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly While the character's ASC holds this, the mouth cycles MouthShapes. Empty = never talks.
    Mouth Shapes MouthShapes TArray<FName> XenoCore › Face › Mouth EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly Mouth curves the generic talking flap cycles through.
    Mouth Shape Interval MouthShapeInterval float XenoCore › Face › Mouth EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.03 0.11 Seconds each mouth shape is held during the talking flap.
    Mouth Weight MouthWeight float XenoCore › Face › Mouth EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.6 How far the mouth opens during the talking flap, 0..1.
    Lip Sync bLipSync bool XenoCore › Face › Lip Sync EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly true Off = voice lines only flap the mouth, ignoring their lip-sync keys.
    Lip Sync Weight Scale LipSyncWeightScale float XenoCore › Face › Lip Sync EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=2 1.0 Multiplies every lip-sync key's weight. Raise for a model whose mouth shapes read small.
    Lip Sync Blend Speed LipSyncBlendSpeed float XenoCore › Face › Lip Sync EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1 30.0 How fast the mouth moves between lip-sync shapes, per second. Higher is snappier.

    XenoCoreRuntime / Arts¶

    EXenoCoreArtAICheck¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    What a companion checks before using an art.

    Value Shown as Description
    TargetHasTag Target Has Tag The enemy carries Tag - a reaction (Break/Topple/Daze), a status, an aura, a phase.
    TargetLacksTag Target Lacks Tag No description.
    TargetHealthBelow Target Health Below The enemy's health is below Percent.
    TargetHealthAbove Target Health Above No description.
    IHoldTargetAggro I Hold Target Aggro The enemy's current target (its highest aggro) is this companion.
    IDoNotHoldTargetAggro I Do Not Hold Target Aggro No description.
    TargetFacingMe Target Facing Me The enemy faces this companion (within its front arc).
    TargetNotFacingMe Target Not Facing Me No description.
    AllyHealthBelowHealThreshold Ally Health Below Heal Threshold Some living party member is below the companion's Heal Threshold (its AI profile).
    RecipientLacksTag Recipient Lacks Tag Whoever the art lands on - the chosen ally, or the user for a self/party art - lacks Tag. Stops re-buffing.

    EXenoCoreArtArea¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    XC1's "Range" line - how many it reaches. Only meaningful for an Enemy-targeted art.

    Value Shown as Description
    Single Single No description.
    CircleAroundUser Circle Around User No description.
    CircleAroundTarget Circle Around Target No description.
    Cone Cone No description.

    EXenoCoreArtAttribute¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    Whether an art is physical or ether. Separate from Category, which is the art's type colour. An ether art uses Ether and Ether Defence instead of Strength and Physical Defence.

    Value Shown as Description
    Physical Physical No description.
    Ether Ether No description.

    EXenoCoreArtCategory¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    The eight art categories. Drives the palette slot's colour, per XC1's reaction colour language.

    Value Shown as Description
    Physical Physical No description.
    Ether Ether No description.
    Break Break No description.
    Topple Topple Knocks a Broken target down. Green in XC1's colour language.
    Daze Daze Stuns a Toppled target. Yellow in XC1's colour language.
    Buff Buff Strengthens the user or the party.
    Debuff Debuff No description.
    Heal Heal No description.

    EXenoCoreArtEffect¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    Whether the art's magnitude is dealt or restored.

    Value Shown as Description
    Damage Damage No description.
    Heal Heal No description.
    None None A pure buff or debuff - the art's Effects list is all it does.

    EXenoCoreArtEffectCondition¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    When an Effects entry applies.

    Value Shown as Description
    Always Always No description.
    InPosition In Position The art's own PositionalRequirement is met.
    FromSide From Side No description.
    FromBehind From Behind The user is behind the target.
    TargetBroken Target Broken No description.
    TargetToppled Target Toppled No description.
    TargetDazed Target Dazed No description.
    FromFront From Front No description.

    EXenoCoreArtEffectRecipient¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    Who an Effects entry lands on.

    Value Shown as Description
    Target Target Each target the art hits.
    User User The caster - a self buff riding an attack.
    Party Party Every active party member.

    EXenoCoreArtPositional¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    Where the user must be standing relative to the target for the art's rider to apply.

    Value Shown as Description
    None None No description.
    Back Back No description.
    Side Side No description.
    Front Front In front of the target. Appended last so saved values of the others do not change.

    EXenoCoreArtTargetType¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    Who the art is aimed at: the enemy, the user, one ally, or the whole party.

    Value Shown as Description
    Enemy Enemy No description.
    User User The caster.
    Ally Ally One party member, chosen with the ally selector.
    Party Party Every active party member at once.

    FXenoCoreArtAICondition¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    One AI condition on an art. Required conditions gate the art; bonus conditions add to its score.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Check Check EXenoCoreArtAICheck AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtAICheck::TargetHasTag What this condition checks.
    Tag Tag FGameplayTag AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly For the tag checks.
    Percent Percent float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0 50.0 For the health checks, 0-100.
    Still Active On Impact bStillActiveOnImpact bool AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly false For "Target has tag": pass only if the tag will still be on the target when this art lands.
    Required bRequired bool AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly true Required: the art is not used unless this passes. Unticked: passing adds Bonus to its score.
    Bonus Bonus float AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=!bRequired 1.0 Score added when an optional condition passes.

    FXenoCoreArtEffectEntry¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Arts/XenoCoreArtDefinition.h · BlueprintType

    One status an art applies - a debuff, a buff, or a reaction.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Effect Effect TSubclassOf<class UGameplayEffect> Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The status - pick from GE_XenoCore_Status_* or GE_XenoCore_Reaction_*.
    Chance Chance float Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0 1.0 Probability, 0 to 1, that this status is applied when the art lands.
    Duration Duration FScalableFloat Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Seconds, scaled by art level, sent as XenoCore.Status.Duration. Leave at 0 only for a status with its own fixed duration, such as a reaction.
    Magnitude Magnitude FScalableFloat Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Strength, scaled by art level; what it means is the status's own. 0 = not sent.
    Condition Condition EXenoCoreArtEffectCondition Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtEffectCondition::Always No description.
    Recipient Recipient EXenoCoreArtEffectRecipient Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtEffectRecipient::Target Who this status lands on: each target hit, the user, or the whole party.
    Announce Chance bAnnounceChance bool Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly true For a positional condition (front / side / behind / in position): light the palette's Chance while the user stands there. So Air Slash's "Slow from the side" is announced like Back Slash's double damage from behind.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Ability Class AbilityClass TSubclassOf<class UXenoCoreGameplayAbility_Art> Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The ability class granted when this art is equipped. Leave it at the shared art class and an art is one asset - this definition and nothing else.

    Time Dilation Start TimeDilationStart float Art › Time Dilation EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0, EditCondition=TimeDilation < 1.0 0.0 Where in the montage the slow-down starts, as a fraction of its length. 0 = from the start.
    Time Dilation End TimeDilationEnd float Art › Time Dilation EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0, EditCondition=TimeDilation < 1.0 1.0 Where it ends, as a fraction of the montage. 1 = until the art ends.

    Palette Order PaletteOrder int32 Art › Palette EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 0 Fallback palette order for a pawn with no party record (lower is further left). Party characters use their palette slots instead.
    Category Category EXenoCoreArtCategory Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtCategory::Physical The art's type, which sets its colour on the palette.
    Base Level Up Cost BaseLevelUpCost int32 Art › Level EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0 300 AP to raise this art from I to ii. Each further level multiplies it by UXenoCoreProgressionComponent::ArtLevelCostMultipliers.

    Target Type TargetType EXenoCoreArtTargetType Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtTargetType::Enemy XC1's "Target". One ally opens the party selector (Light Heal); Whole party hits everyone with no choice to make; User is the caster alone.
    Area Area EXenoCoreArtArea Art › Area EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreArtArea::Single XC1's "Range" - how many enemies it reaches.
    Area Radius AreaRadius float Art › Area EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, EditCondition=Area != EXenoCoreArtArea::Single, Units=Centimeters 500.0 Radius of a circle, or the length of a cone. Typed in cm; the editor shows the unit.
    Cone Angle ConeAngle float Art › Area EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1.0, ClampMax=360.0, EditCondition=Area == EXenoCoreArtArea::Cone, Units=Degrees 90.0 Full width of a cone, in degrees.
    Distance Distance float Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, Units=Centimeters 420.0 XC1's "Distance" - how close to its target the user must be for the art to strike. Used from further away, the character runs in first.
    Effects Effects TArray<FXenoCoreArtEffectEntry> Art › Effects EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Every status this art applies - debuffs, buffs, and the Break / Topple / Daze reaction.
    Cooldown Duration CooldownDuration FScalableFloat Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly How long this art recharges for, in seconds.
    Cooldown Tag CooldownTag FGameplayTag Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The tag that marks this art as recharging. Must be unique per art.
    Power Power FScalableFloat Art EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The art's magnitude, scaled by art level.
    Positional Bonuses PositionalBonuses TArray<FXenoCoreArtPositionalBonus> Art › Positional EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Where standing pays off - one entry per position, each with its multiplier and whether it announces a Chance. A list, so an art can reward the side and the back; it replaced a single PositionalRequirement, which migrates in on load.
    Hits Hits int32 Art › Hits EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1, ClampMax=10 1 How many times the art strikes. Each hit deals the full Power.
    Hit Spacing HitSpacing float Art › Hits EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0, EditCondition=Hits > 1 0.1 Gap between hits, as a fraction of the montage. The first lands at ImpactFraction.
    Impact Event Tag ImpactEventTag FGameplayTag Art › Hits EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Every time the montage sends this event is one hit. Empty = use ImpactFraction / Hits.
    Force Multiplier ForceMultiplier float Art › Hits EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMax=5.0 1.0 How hard each hit knocks its target back, as a multiple of the target's PushDistance. 0 = none.
    Lunge Multiplier LungeMultiplier float Art › Hits EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMax=5.0 0.0 Lyra's melee lunge: the first connecting hit also drives the user into its target by the art ability's Lunge.Strength x this. 0 = none.
    Talent Charge TalentCharge float Art › Talent Gauge EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0 0.0 Talent Gauge gained from this art, out of 100. 0 = none.
    Talent Charge Per Enemy Hit bTalentChargePerEnemyHit bool Art › Talent Gauge EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=TalentCharge > 0.0 false Pay TalentCharge for every enemy hit, on every hit, instead of once per cast. XC1: Stream Edge fills per enemy hit.
    Threat Threat float Art › Aggro EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0 10.0 Temporary aggro drawn from each enemy struck: this x (user's level + 14). 0 = none.
    Usable By AI bUsableByAI bool Art › Companion AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly true Untick to keep this art player-only.
    AI Priority AIPriority float Art › Companion AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=bUsableByAI 1.0 Base score for companion AI. The highest-scoring usable art wins; ties go to palette order.
    AI Chain Bonus AIChainBonus float Art › Companion AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, EditCondition=bUsableByAI 3.0 Extra score while this art's reaction can land - a Topple effect on a Broken target, a Daze on a Toppled one. Read from Effects; 0 = off.
    AI Wait For Reaction bAIWaitForReaction bool Art › Companion AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=bUsableByAI true Hold this art until its reaction can land (a Topple art until the target is Broken, a Daze art until Toppled).
    AI Conditions AIConditions TArray<FXenoCoreArtAICondition> Art › Companion AI EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=bUsableByAI When a companion uses this art. Empty = whenever it is ready (a Heal art implicitly waits for an ally below the heal threshold).

    Cast Sound CastSound TObjectPtr<USoundBase> Art › Cosmetics EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Played on the user when the art starts.
    Impact FX ImpactFX TObjectPtr<UFXSystemAsset> Art › Cosmetics EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Spawned on every target, on every hit, where the strike lands.
    Impact Sound ImpactSound TObjectPtr<USoundBase> Art › Cosmetics EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Played on every target, on every hit, where the strike lands.
    Area FX AreaFX TObjectPtr<UFXSystemAsset> Art › Cosmetics EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, EditCondition=Area != EXenoCoreArtArea::Single Spawned once per hit at the centre of an area art, on the ground.

    The free auto-attack that runs while engaged.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Incapacitated Tags IncapacitatedTags FGameplayTagContainer XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly While the attacker carries any of these it does not swing: the loop pauses, a one-shot ends, and a swing already in flight does not connect.
    Talent Charge Effect TalentChargeEffect TSubclassOf<UGameplayEffect> XenoCore › Talent EditDefaultsOnly Instant effect carrying the charge onto the attacker's TalentGauge.
    Attack Range AttackRange float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 420.0 How far the swing reaches.
    Contact Reach Tolerance ContactReachTolerance float XenoCore › Attack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 60.0 Extra reach allowed at contact only, never when starting a swing.
    Force Multiplier ForceMultiplier float XenoCore › Attack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMax=5.0 1.0 How hard each landed swing knocks its target back, as a multiple of the target's PushDistance. 0 = none.
    Lunge Multiplier LungeMultiplier float XenoCore › Attack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMax=5.0 0.0 Lyra's melee lunge: each connecting swing also drives the attacker into its target by Lunge.Strength x this. 0 = none.
    Lunge Lunge FXenoCoreHitLunge XenoCore › Attack EditDefaultsOnly The lunge itself - Lyra's GA_Melee values by default.
    Target Source TargetSource EXenoCoreAttackTargetSource XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly EXenoCoreAttackTargetSource::TargetLock Where to get the target. Data, not a subclass - the player and an enemy differ by this and bRequiresArming and nothing else, so a bespoke C++ ability per attacker would be two classes to express two booleans.
    Requires Arming bRequiresArming bool XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly true Whether this attacker draws before swinging.
    Swing Recovery SwingRecovery float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.35 Idle gap between one swing finishing and the next starting.
    Out Of Range Retry OutOfRangeRetry float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.05 0.2 How often to re-check reach while paused out of range. Cheap, so it can be responsive.
    Arm Poll ArmPoll float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.02 0.05 How often to re-check whether the draw has finished.
    Damage Effect DamageEffect TSubclassOf<UGameplayEffect> XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly The damage effect each landed swing applies. Without one the attack deals no damage.
    Attack Montages AttackMontages TArray<TObjectPtr<UAnimMontage>> XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly Swing animations, played in order and wrapped - Kwang's A/B/C primary chain.
    Attack Montages Stationary AttackMontagesStationary TArray<TObjectPtr<UAnimMontage>> XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly The same swings on the full body slot, played when the character is standing still.
    Face Target On Attack bFaceTargetOnAttack bool XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly false Snap the avatar's yaw onto the target when a swing starts.
    Face Target Turn Rate FaceTargetTurnRate float XenoCore › Attack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.0 Defaults to 0 - the one-frame snap. Turning is opt-in, because it changes how every attack in the game looks.
    Root Motion When Stationary bRootMotionWhenStationary bool XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly true Let a stationary swing drive the capsule from its root motion, and ignore root motion entirely while moving.
    Cancel Full Body On Move bCancelFullBodyOnMove bool XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly true Hand a full-body swing over to its upper-body twin the moment the player starts moving.
    Full Body Cancel Blend Out FullBodyCancelBlendOut float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.1 Blend used when handing the swing over. Short, or the legs slide through the blend.
    Additional Effects AdditionalEffects TArray<TSubclassOf<UGameplayEffect>> XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly Extra effects applied to the target on a landed hit, alongside the damage.
    Loop Swings bLoopSwings bool XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly true Keep swinging on a timer. True for an auto-attack, false for an art.
    Stationary Speed Threshold StationarySpeedThreshold float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 20.0 Below this ground speed the character counts as standing still.
    Montage Play Rate MontagePlayRate float XenoCore › AutoAttack EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.1 1.0 Clips run ~1.2s; raise this for XC1's snappier read without re-authoring them.

    AXenoCoreEnemyController¶

    Class · derives from AModularAIController · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Enemies/XenoCoreEnemyController.h · Blueprintable

    The AI controller enemies are possessed by. It carries the enemy's team; the behaviour itself lives in a StateTree on the pawn's StateTree AI component. Set the team before possession: the pawn reads it once, when it is possessed.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Detection Interval DetectionInterval float XenoCore › AI › Detection EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.05 0.2 Seconds between detection checks.
    Running Speed RunningSpeed float XenoCore › AI › Detection EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, Units=CentimetersPerSecond 280.0 Sound detection only hears a leader moving faster than this.
    Heal On Give Up bHealOnGiveUp bool XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly true Restore full health when this enemy gives up a fight.
    Provoked Give Up Seconds ProvokedGiveUpSeconds float XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0 10.0 Seconds a provoked enemy that never engaged waits with nobody in reach before it gives up (and heals).
    Engage Radius EngageRadius float XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0 1600.0 Enemy notices the player inside this. The default for every enemy this controller possesses; an enemy can override it with its own Engage Radius Override.
    Leash Radius LeashRadius float XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0 7000.0 Beyond this distance from home the enemy gives up and walks back. Measured from home, not from the player, so a kited enemy cannot be led across the whole zone.
    Disengage Radius Scale DisengageRadiusScale float XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1.0 2.5 An engaged enemy stays engaged out to Engage Radius times this, so one standing on the edge does not flicker in and out of the fight. An enemy can override it with its own Disengage Radius Scale Override.
    Ignore When Levels Below IgnoreWhenLevelsBelow int32 XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1 6 Enemies ignore the party entirely when the leader is this many levels above them, and only fight if attacked first. bAlwaysAggro is the exception for uniques and bosses.
    Always Aggro bAlwaysAggro bool XenoCore › AI EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly false Skip the level rule: this enemy detects the party whatever the level gap. For uniques and bosses.
    Team Id TeamId int32 XenoCore › Teams EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly 2 The team every enemy using this controller belongs to. An int32 rather than FGenericTeamId because that is what ULyraTeamSubsystem speaks and what Lyra's team assets are keyed on.

    Keeps a squad of enemies alive here and respawns them after they fall, out of the party's sight. One spawner is one squad: its members wander round it, fight together, and only the last kill drops a chest.

    How this enemy notices the party before being attacked.

    Value Shown as Description
    None None Non-aggressive: fights only when attacked.
    Sight Sight Starts a fight when the party leader enters its view cone.
    Sound Sound Starts a fight when the party leader runs nearby. Walking is quiet enough to pass.
    Ether Ether Starts a fight when the party uses an ether art nearby - even a harmless one.

    StayBack Stay Back Hold back from the target and fight with what reaches from there (xcx "Use ranged attacks!").

    What one objective asks for.

    DefeatEnemy Defeat Enemy Defeat N of an enemy class. Counted from XenoCore.Enemy.Message.Defeated.

    ReachLocation Reach Location Walk into the Quest Location whose Location Id is Target Id.

    EXenoCoreQuestSort¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Quest/XenoCoreQuestUIStatics.h · BlueprintType

    How the Quest Log orders its rows. Y cycles through these in order.

    Value Shown as Description
    Status Status Ready to report, then in progress, then finished. What you can act on, first.
    Name Name Title, A-Z.
    Area Area Area, A-Z, then title - so one place's quests read as a group.
    Type Type Collection, Material, Monster... then title.

    EXenoCoreQuestStatus¶

    Enum · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Quest/XenoCoreQuestComponent.h · BlueprintType

    Where one quest has got to.

    Value Shown as Description
    Unknown Unknown Never answered. Offerable.
    Declined Declined Turned down. Still offerable - XC1 lets the player come back.
    Active Active Accepted, objectives outstanding.
    ReadyToTurnIn Ready To Turn In Every objective met. Waiting for the player to walk back to the giver.
    Complete Complete Turned in and paid. Terminal.

    UXenoCoreSaveSubsystem¶

    Class · derives from UGameInstanceSubsystem · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Save/XenoCoreSaveSubsystem.h

    Same rule as GetPartyInventory, GetPartyQuests and GetTargetModeAbility: one resolver, and everything else goes through it. Nothing else names a slot, writes a file, or decides whether a load is in progress.

    Events you can bind

    Event Type Description
    OnSaveWritten FXenoCoreSaveWritten Broadcast when a save finishes writing, with the slot and whether it succeeded.
    OnSaveStarted FXenoCoreSaveStarted Broadcast when a save begins writing.
    OnSaveRestored FXenoCoreSaveRestored Broadcast once a loaded save has been applied to the world.
    OnSaveLoaded FXenoCoreSaveLoaded Broadcast once a loaded save has been fully applied, with the slot it came from.

    Blueprint functions

    Node Kind Signature Description
    Get Pure UXenoCoreSaveSubsystem* Get() The one resolver.
    Get Slot Name Pure FString GetSlotName(int32 SlotIndex) "XenoCore_Auto" or "XenoCore_01".."XenoCore_03".
    Load All Slots Callable TArray<UXenoCoreSaveGame*> LoadAllSlots() Reads every slot's file so the list screen can draw its rows.
    Load Slot Callable UXenoCoreSaveGame* LoadSlot(int32 SlotIndex) One slot, or null when it is empty.
    Save To Slot Callable bool SaveToSlot(int32 SlotIndex) Captures the world and writes it to a slot, asynchronously.
    Request Autosave Callable bool RequestAutosave(const FString& Reason) Writes to the autosave slot.
    Delete Slot Callable bool DeleteSlot(int32 SlotIndex) Deletes a slot's file.
    Can Save Now Pure bool CanSaveNow() const True when a save is allowed right now; false in combat or under a menu.
    Is Save In Progress Pure bool IsSaveInProgress() const True while a write is actually in flight.
    Is Autosave In Progress Pure bool IsAutosaveInProgress() const Which slot the in-flight write is going to, or NoSlotIndex when nothing is being written.
    Load From Slot Callable bool LoadFromSlot(int32 SlotIndex) Loads a slot: stashes it, then travels to its map.
    Is Restoring From Save Pure bool IsRestoringFromSave() const Starting inventory and starting equipment are seeded from the ASC-ready delegate on every pawn's first body, and the roster is seeded from StartingRoster in BeginPlay.
    Was World Loaded From Save Pure bool WasWorldLoadedFromSave() const True for the whole life of a world that was loaded from a save.
    Begin New Game Callable void BeginNewGame() Starting a new game: forget that anything was ever loaded, so seeding runs normally again.
    Restore Pending Save Callable void RestorePendingSave(APlayerController* PlayerController) Applies the pending save to the world, in the one order that works.
    Get Loaded Slot Index Pure int32 GetLoadedSlotIndex() const The slot this game was last loaded from, or NoSlotIndex (the lowest int32) if none.
    Register Save Participant Callable void RegisterSaveParticipant(UObject* Participant, FName SaveKey = NAME_None) Adds an actor, component or object to the save.
    Unregister Save Participant Callable void UnregisterSaveParticipant(UObject* Participant) Removes a participant from the save, keeping what it last held.
    Forget Save Record Callable bool ForgetSaveRecord(FName SaveKey) No description.
    Has Save Record Pure bool HasSaveRecord(FName SaveKey) const True when a record is held under this key.
    Get Play Time Seconds Pure float GetPlayTimeSeconds() const Seconds of play in this save, across sessions.
    Format Play Time Pure FText FormatPlayTime(float Seconds) Play time as XC1 prints it: "1:55".
    Has Unsaved Progress Pure bool HasUnsavedProgress() const Has anything been played since the last save, autosave or load?
    Capture Thumbnail Callable void CaptureThumbnail() Grab the world as it looks right now, for the next save's slot picture.
    Set Location Text Callable void SetLocationText(const FString& Location) The location and story line the slot row prints.
    Set Story Text Callable void SetStoryText(const FString& Story) Overrides UXenoCoreSaveSettings::DefaultStoryText.
    Get Current Location Text Pure FString GetCurrentLocationText() const What a save written now would print for its location: the override, else the map's name, else empty.
    Get Current Story Text Pure FString GetCurrentStoryText() const What a save written now would print for its story line.

    The moments XC1's timed skills fire on. Each is sourced from a skill that uses it.

    OnMiss On Miss XC1's "(on miss)" - Speed Strike. This body's attack is evaded.
    OnCritical On Critical XC1's "(on crit)". This body lands a critical hit.

    FXenoCoreSkillEntry¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Skills/XenoCoreSkillTypes.h · BlueprintType

    One skill. It does its work in up to three ways, each optional, all driven by one Value: - Stats - always on while it reaches the body (Equipment Master: Weight -5). - Bonus - a percentage another system asks for (Healing Wisdom: healing +15 %). - Ability - behaviour, a UXenoCoreGameplayAbility_Skill child (Underdog: a buff at battle start). The skill counterpart of an art: data pointing at behaviour, and most skills need no behaviour.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Display Name DisplayName FText Skill EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The skill's name in the Skills menu and the "Skill Learnt" popup.
    Description Description FText Skill EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly May contain {Value}, filled from Value - "Reduces equipment weight by {Value}."
    Shape Shape EXenoCoreSkillShape Skill EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreSkillShape::Circle The frame the skill's icon is drawn in.
    Timing Timing EXenoCoreSkillTiming Skill EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreSkillTiming::Always Always applies, or only while the owner is in the battle party (the icon's colour).
    Scope Scope EXenoCoreSkillScope Skill EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreSkillScope::Self Who the skill reaches: its owner, the battle party, or the whole party (the icon's glyph).
    Value Value float Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly 0.0 XC1's "Effect Value" - what Stats add, what a Bonus is worth, what an Ability reads.
    Duration Duration float Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.0 Seconds, for a timed skill (XC1's "time" column) - read by its Ability. 0 for none.
    Stats Stats TArray<FXenoCoreSkillStatMod> Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Stats raised by Value while the skill reaches the body. Resilient Warrior raises two.
    Condition Condition EXenoCoreSkillCondition Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly EXenoCoreSkillCondition::Always When the Stats hold. Always for most skills; re-checked as HP and armour change.
    Condition Threshold ConditionThreshold float Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0, EditCondition=Condition == EXenoCoreSkillCondition::HealthAtOrBelow || Condition == EXenoCoreSkillCondition::HealthAtOrAbove 50.0 Percent of max HP, for the two health conditions.
    Chance Chance float Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=100.0 100.0 Percent chance an Ability's trigger actually fires - XC1's "75% chance" (Hero's Valour). 100 = always.
    Bonus Bonus FGameplayTag Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, Categories=XenoCore.SkillBonus A percentage another system asks for - UXenoCoreProgressionComponent::GetSkillBonus. Quest EXP and healing ask today; a buyer's system asks with its own tag, and no skill code changes.
    Ability Ability TSubclassOf<UXenoCoreGameplayAbility_Skill> Skill › Effect EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Behaviour - granted to the body while the skill reaches it. A UXenoCoreGameplayAbility_Skill child.
    SP Cost Override SPCostOverride int32 Skill › Advanced EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=-1 -1 SP to learn this one skill. -1 (the default) uses the branch's cost curve; anything else replaces it.
    Link Cost LinkCost int32 Skill › Advanced EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0 0 Not implemented yet: the Affinity Coins another character pays to link this. Read by nothing.

    The base for GA_XenoCore_TargetMode. It exists to hold the selected target and to be the only thing that writes it - everything else about the mode (input, indicator, the poll) is Blueprint in the child.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Current Target CurrentTarget TObjectPtr<AActor> XenoCore › Targeting BlueprintReadOnly, Transient nullptr Transient on purpose.
    Target Indicator Material TargetIndicatorMaterial TObjectPtr<UMaterialInterface> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly The indicator drawn on the targeted enemy - XC1 marks the enemy itself, not the ground.
    Target Acquired Sound TargetAcquiredSound TObjectPtr<USoundBase> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly Played each time a target is acquired or cycled to. Null is legal and silent.
    Target Indicator Size TargetIndicatorSize float XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 250.0 Size of the quad in world units - not of the diamond, which is drawn inside it.
    Strafe While Locked bStrafeWhileLocked bool XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly true No description.
    Strafe Max Range StrafeMaxRange float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 400.0 Beyond it the pawn returns to orient-to-movement and free-roam locomotion, even though the lock is still held.
    Strafe Range Release Scale StrafeRangeReleaseScale float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=1.0 1.2 Hysteresis, so standing exactly on the boundary does not flip facing every frame.
    Retreat Dot Threshold RetreatDotThreshold float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=-1.0, ClampMax=0.0 -0.9 How directly the player must be moving away from the target before facing locks to it.
    Strafe Stationary Speed StrafeStationarySpeed float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 20.0 Below this speed the player counts as standing still, and keeps facing the target.
    Target Indicator Height Fraction TargetIndicatorHeightFraction float XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly 0.35 Height above the target's origin, as a fraction of its capsule half-height.
    Lock Acquire Range LockAcquireRange float XenoCore › Targeting › Range EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, Units=cm 3000.0 No description.
    Lock Keep Range LockKeepRange float XenoCore › Targeting › Range EditDefaultsOnly, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0.0, Units=cm 3000.0 Must be at least Lock Acquire Range; set it higher so a target at the edge is not dropped the moment it steps back.
    Target Indicator Screen Space Size bTargetIndicatorScreenSpaceSize bool XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly false Keep the indicator the same size on screen regardless of distance.
    Offscreen Arrow Material OffscreenArrowMaterial TObjectPtr<UMaterialInterface> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly The arrows drawn at the screen edge when the target is off screen, pointing back at it.
    Arrow Screen Edge Inset ArrowScreenEdgeInset float XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0, UIMin=0.0, UIMax=1.0 0.88 How far in from the viewport edge the arrows sit, as a fraction of half-width/height.
    Arrow Camera Distance ArrowCameraDistance float XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=1.0, UIMin=1.0 200.0 Distance in front of the camera to place the arrows. Size is scaled with it.
    Arrow Screen Size Fraction ArrowScreenSizeFraction float XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, UIMin=0.0 0.16 Apparent size, as a fraction of ArrowCameraDistance.
    Invert Arrow Direction bInvertArrowDirection bool XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly false Flips which way the chevrons point, if the plane's UVs run the other way.
    Offscreen Arrow Mesh OffscreenArrowMesh TObjectPtr<UStaticMesh> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly Plane the arrows are drawn on. Engine unit plane unless overridden.
    Target Plate Class TargetPlateClass TSubclassOf<UXenoCoreTargetPlateBase> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly The top-centre badge naming the target. Owned here for the same reason the diamond and the arrows are: it is part of the lock, so its lifetime is the lock's lifetime and it cannot be left on screen by a path that forgot to clear it.
    Player Plate Class PlayerPlateClass TSubclassOf<UXenoCorePlayerPlateBase> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly The upper-left player readout.
    Arts Palette Class ArtsPaletteClass TSubclassOf<UXenoCoreArtsPaletteBase> XenoCore › Targeting EditDefaultsOnly The arts palette. Same lifetime as the badge and the player plate.
    Approach Timeout ApproachTimeout float XenoCore › Targeting › Approach EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.1 4.0 Give up running in after this long - an unreachable target must not hold the input forever.
    Approach Arrive Margin ApproachArriveMargin float XenoCore › Targeting › Approach EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 60.0 Stop this far inside the art's Distance before striking, so the target stepping back during the windup still leaves it within reach plus the contact tolerance.
    Approach Stick Cancel ApproachStickCancel float XenoCore › Targeting › Approach EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0, ClampMax=1.0 0.35 Pushing the stick past this during a run hands control back: the run ends and nothing is cast - no cooldown, no gauge.
    Approach Move Action ApproachMoveAction TSoftObjectPtr<class UInputAction> XenoCore › Targeting › Approach EditDefaultsOnly The move action whose value is read to tell the player's stick from the run's own steering.
    Camera Focus Duration CameraFocusDuration float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.0 0.3 Seconds the focus takes. Zero disables it entirely.
    Strafe Evaluate Interval StrafeEvaluateInterval float XenoCore › TargetMode EditDefaultsOnly, ClampMin=0.01 0.05 Poll interval. Facing interpolates at RotationRate, so this need not be per-frame.

    FXenoCoreUIEffectPlayback¶

Every other number over an enemy is Lyra's (its damage cue and number-pop style); a zero never reaches that cue, because zero damage applies no damage at all.

    Tutorial Table TutorialTable TSoftObjectPtr<UDataTable> Tutorials Config, EditAnywhere Every tutorial card - one row each, in the order a sequence shows them. Rows must be XenoCoreTutorialRow; each row's Triggers decide when it appears.

    UXenoCoreBattleVoiceConfig¶

    Class · derives from UPrimaryDataAsset · header XenoCoreRuntime/Public/Voice/XenoCoreBattleVoiceTypes.h · BlueprintType

    Global battle-voice settings: the rules table, pacing, and how a line is played.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Rules Rules TObjectPtr<UDataTable> Rules EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly How often each category is heard. Row type: XenoCoreVoiceRuleRow.
    Gap Seconds GapSeconds float Pacing EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 0.8 Silence after a line ends before the next may start. This is what makes seven voices take turns.
    Reference Party Size ReferencePartySize int32 Pacing EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=1 3 The party size the AI chances are written for. XC1 fields three.
    Reply Delay Seconds ReplyDelaySeconds float Pacing EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 0.25 Pause between a line and the Addressee's reply.
    Attenuation Attenuation TSoftObjectPtr<USoundAttenuation> Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Pans the voice by where the speaker stands. The listener is the camera.
    Line Concurrency LineConcurrency TSoftObjectPtr<USoundConcurrency> Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Limits ordinary lines. The subsystem already allows one at a time; this is the audio engine's backstop.
    Effort Concurrency EffortConcurrency TSoftObjectPtr<USoundConcurrency> Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly Limits overlapping grunts and hurt sounds.
    Sound Class SoundClass TSoftObjectPtr<USoundClass> Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly The sound class every imported voice line is given. Its modulation follows Lyra's Dialogue volume.
    Show In Dialogue Box ShowInDialogueBox FGameplayTagContainer Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, Categories=XenoCore.Voice These categories also show their line in the dialogue box over the speaker (talk-to-ally). The rest are voice only.
    Dialogue Box Linger DialogueBoxLinger float Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 1.0 How long the box stays up after a boxed line's audio ends.
    Attach Socket AttachSocket FName Playback EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly "head" Bone or socket on the pawn's mesh the voice is attached to, so it pans with a moving speaker.
    Strong Level Gap StrongLevelGap int32 Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0 3 Battle start reads "strong" when the nearest enemy is at least this many levels above the speaker.
    Weak Level Gap WeakLevelGap int32 Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0 3 Battle start reads "weak" when the nearest enemy is at least this many levels below the speaker.
    Battle Start Radius BattleStartRadius float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=cm 3000.0 How far to look for the enemy a battle-start line is about.
    Low Health Fraction LowHealthFraction float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.3 A party member says LowHP when a hit takes them below this fraction of their max HP.
    Enemy Low Health Fraction EnemyLowHealthFraction float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.25 Enemy.Low is said when a party hit takes the enemy below this fraction of its max HP.
    Close Victory Health Fraction CloseVictoryHealthFraction float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.25 A win is Close when someone was downed in the fight, or the leader ends below this fraction of max HP.
    Victory Line Delay VictoryLineDelay float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 1.2 Delay after the win before the victory line, so it lands over the fanfare's tail rather than its first note.
    Field Banter Interval FieldBanterInterval float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 20.0 How often out-of-battle banter is considered. The Field rules decide whether anything is said.
    Field Scenery Chance FieldSceneryChance float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.3 Of the idle remarks, the share that are about the scenery (Field.Scenery) instead.
    Field Exchange Chance FieldExchangeChance float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.35 Chance a banter tick is a two-person exchange (Field.Exchange, then Field.Reply) rather than a remark.
    Field Watch Interval FieldWatchInterval float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 1.0 How often the party looks around for enemies and stragglers (Field.EnemySighted, Field.WaitUp). 0 = never.
    Enemy Sighted Radius EnemySightedRadius float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=cm 2500.0 An enemy, not yet fighting, this close to the leader is announced once (Field.EnemySighted).
    Wait Up Distance WaitUpDistance float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=cm 1500.0 A companion this far behind a moving leader calls out (Field.WaitUp).
    Reinforcement After Seconds ReinforcementAfterSeconds float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=s 5.0 An enemy engaging this long after the fight started counts as reinforcements (Enemy.Reinforcement).
    Aid Given Chance AidGivenChance float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, ClampMax=1 0.5 Of heal and buff casts, the share that say an Aid.Given line ("Hang on, I've got you!") instead of the art's name.
    Field Travel Speed FieldTravelSpeed float Triggers EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=cm/s 150.0 Above this leader speed the party is travelling (Field.Travel), below it idle (Field.Idle).
    Exchange Max Distance ExchangeMaxDistance float Who Is Speaking EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly, ClampMin=0, Units=cm 500.0 Two members further apart than this are never paired for a Field.Exchange. 0 = any distance.
    Look At Addressee bLookAtAddressee bool Who Is Speaking EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadOnly true A line with an addressee makes speaker and addressee look at each other for its length.

    FXenoCoreRandomPlayerEntry¶

    Struct · header XenoCoreEditor/Public/XenoCoreAnimLayerTools.h · BlueprintType

    One entry in a state's Random Sequence Player: a clip, how often it gets picked, and how it comes in over whatever played before it.

    Properties

    Property C++ name Type Category Specifiers Default Description
    Sequence Sequence TObjectPtr<UAnimSequenceBase> XenoCore EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite nullptr No description.
    Chance To Play ChanceToPlay float XenoCore EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, ClampMin=0 1.0 Relative pick weight, normalised against every other entry. Ignored in shuffle mode.
    Min Loop Count MinLoopCount int32 XenoCore EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, ClampMin=0 0 No description.
    Max Loop Count MaxLoopCount int32 XenoCore EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, ClampMin=0 0 No description.
    Min Play Rate MinPlayRate float XenoCore EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite, ClampMin=0 1.0 Play rate is randomised in this range each time the entry is picked.

    Blueprint functions

    Node Kind Signature Description
    Add Anim Layer To Interface Callable bool AddAnimLayerToInterface(UAnimBlueprint* InterfaceBlueprint, FName LayerName) Declares an animation layer on an Anim Layer Interface asset.
    Implement Anim Layer Interface Callable bool ImplementAnimLayerInterface(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, UAnimBlueprint* InterfaceBlueprint) Makes Blueprint implement InterfaceBlueprint's layers.
    Remove Anim Layer Interface Callable bool RemoveAnimLayerInterface(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, UAnimBlueprint* InterfaceBlueprint, bool bPreserveFunctions = false) Drops an implemented anim layer interface, discarding its layer graphs.
    Add Linked Anim Layer Node Callable FString AddLinkedAnimLayerNode(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, UAnimBlueprint* InterfaceBlueprint, FName LayerName, UAnimBlueprint* DefaultLayerBlueprint, FName GraphName = NAME_None) Adds a Linked Anim Layer node to a graph and drives that graph's Output Pose from it.
    Describe State Machine Callable FString DescribeStateMachine(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint) Dumps a state machine's topology as JSON: every state with the asset driving it, and every transition with its endpoints, rule variable, crossfade and automatic-rule flag.
    Set Transition Automatic Rule Callable FString SetTransitionAutomaticRule(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName FromState, FName ToState, bool bEnabled) Turns "Automatic Rule Based on Sequence Player in State" on or off for one transition, identified by the states it joins.
    Move Graph Content Callable FString MoveGraphContent(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName SourceGraphName, FName DestGraphName) Moves every node except the Output Pose from one graph into another, and re-drives the destination's Output Pose from whatever drove the source's.
    Add Montage Slot Callable FString AddMontageSlot(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FName SlotName) Inserts a montage Slot between whatever currently drives the Output Pose and the Output Pose, in any named graph.
    Add Sequence Player To Graph Callable FString AddSequencePlayerToGraph(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, UAnimSequence* Sequence, bool bLoop = true, bool bExposeSequencePin = false) Adds a Sequence Player to any named graph, and optionally exposes its Sequence as a pin so a variable can drive which clip it plays.
    Add Additive Slot Branch Callable FString AddAdditiveSlotBranch(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FName SlotName) Inserts an additive slot branch before the Output Pose.
    Set Skeleton Slot Group Callable FString SetSkeletonSlotGroup(USkeleton* Skeleton, FName SlotName, FName GroupName) Puts a montage slot in a slot group on a skeleton, creating the group if needed.
    Describe Skeleton Slot Groups Callable FString DescribeSkeletonSlotGroups(USkeleton* Skeleton) Every slot group on a skeleton and its slots, as JSON - the read side of SetSkeletonSlotGroup.
    Set Apply Additive Alpha Callable FString SetApplyAdditiveAlpha(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, float Alpha) Sets the Alpha on every ApplyAdditive node in the graph.
    Add Upper Body Slot Branch Callable FString AddUpperBodySlotBranch(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FName SlotName, FName RootBone) Inserts an upper-body montage slot before the Output Pose.
    Add Inertialization Callable FString AddInertialization(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName) Inserts an Inertialization node immediately before the Output Pose.
    Add Use Cached Pose Callable FString AddUseCachedPose(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FString CacheName, int32 PosX, int32 PosY) Places a "Use cached pose" node bound to the Save cached pose node named CacheName.
    Add Stride Warping Callable FString AddStrideWarping(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FName StrideScaleVariable) Inserts a Stride Warping node directly after the locomotion state machine, with its StrideScale pin driven by a variable get on the named property.
    Expose Anim Node Pin Callable FString ExposeAnimNodePin(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName PropertyName) Ticks "expose as pin" for a named property on every anim node that has it.
    Wire Anim Node Pin Callable FString WireAnimNodePin(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName PinName, FName VariableName, bool bReplaceExisting = false) Drives a named input pin on every anim node that carries it from a variable getter.
    Wire Blend Space Pin Callable FString WireBlendSpacePin(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName PinName, FName VariableName, bool bReplaceExisting = false) Wires a named input pin on every Blend Space Player node to a variable get.
    Set Graph Blend Space Player Callable FString SetGraphBlendSpacePlayer(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, UBlendSpace* BlendSpace) Drives a graph's Output Pose from a bare Blend Space Player, replacing whatever drove it.
    Set Blend Space On Players Callable FString SetBlendSpaceOnPlayers(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, UBlendSpace* BlendSpace) Repoints every Blend Space Player node at a different blend space asset.
    Set State Random Player Callable FString SetStateRandomPlayer(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName StateName, const TArray<FXenoCoreRandomPlayerEntry>& Entries, bool bShuffle = false) Replaces whatever drives a state's Output Pose with a Random Sequence Player over Entries.
    Describe Graphs Callable TArray<FString> DescribeGraphs(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint) Lists graph names on a Blueprint with their concrete UClass, so graph *type* is checkable from script.
    Get Node Comments Callable TArray<FString> GetNodeComments(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName) Reads node comments from a graph, as "NodeName | Class | comment".
    Set Node Comment Callable bool SetNodeComment(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FString NodeName, FString Comment) Sets a node's comment bubble.
    Add Comment Box Callable FString AddCommentBox(UAnimBlueprint* Blueprint, FName GraphName, FString Comment, const TArray<FString>& NodeNames) Adds an EdGraphNode_Comment box around the named nodes, or the whole graph if none given.
    Describe Parent Asset Overrides Callable TArray<FString> DescribeParentAssetOverrides(UAnimBlueprint* ChildBlueprint) Lists what a child anim blueprint currently overrides, resolved back to the parent node so the readout says which clip was replaced rather than a bare guid.
